DDInter1509.mechanism: The concomitant use of HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors and the fiber pectin may result in increased levels of low-density lipoprotein cholesterol. The beneficial effect of the HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor may be reduced. The mechanism is decreased gastrointestinal absorption by the fiber.
